text.tspan: IHI is a high-end Architecture, Interior Design and Furniture studio driven by exquisite taste, unparalleled service and
unmatched quality. From planning spaces with utmost precision, creating unique styles from Modern Luxury to French
Parisian and executing designs with high-end furniture and finishes.
